patterns.message: Import design-system components from 'index.js', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().
Font not provided by the design system. Available: Roboto, Roboto Mono, Flow Circular, Material Symbols Outlined.
<Avatar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: src, alt, monogram, checked, size.
<Badge> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: count, max, anchor, children.
<BottomSheet> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, handle, children.
<Button> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, size, shape, icon, trailingIcon, selected, disabled, href, children.
<Button> variant must be one of 'filled' | 'tonal' | 'elevated' | 'outlined' | 'text'.
<Button> size must be one of 'xs' | 's' | 'm' | 'l' | 'xl'.
<Button> shape must be one of 'round' | 'square'.
<ButtonGroup> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: connected, children.
<Card> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, media, headline, subhead, actions, interactive, children.
<Card> variant must be one of 'elevated' | 'filled' | 'outlined'.
<CarouselItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: image, label.
<Checkbox> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: checked, indeterminate, error, disabled, label, onChange.
<Chip> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, selected, elevated, disabled, leading, trailing, children.
<Chip> variant must be one of 'assist' | 'filter' | 'input' | 'suggestion'.
<DatePicker> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: year, month, selected, today, supportingText, headline, actions, prevIcon, nextIcon, onSelect, onPrev, onNext.
<DeviceFrame> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: width, height, children.
<Dialog> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: icon, headline, actions, open, onScrimClick, children.
<Divider> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: orientation, inset.
<Divider> orientation must be one of 'horizontal' | 'vertical'.
<Divider> inset must be one of 'leading' | 'both'.
<Fab> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: size, color, extended, label, children.
<Fab> size must be one of 'small' | 'medium' | 'large'.
<Fab> color must be one of 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'tertiary' | 'surface'.
<FabMenuItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, icon, onClick.
<FocusIndicator> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: radius, inset, visible.
<Icon> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: name, size.
<IconButton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, size, shape, selected, disabled, label, children.
<IconButton> variant must be one of 'standard' | 'filled' | 'tonal' | 'outlined'.
<IconButton> size must be one of 'xs' | 's' | 'm' | 'l' | 'xl'.
<IconButton> shape must be one of 'round' | 'square'.
<Keyboard> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: configuration, style, suggestions, onKey.
<Keyboard> configuration must be one of 'alphanumeric' | 'keypad' | 'numeric-only'.
<Keyboard> style must be one of 'portrait' | 'landscape' | 'floating'.
<List> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children.
<MenuItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, leading, trailing, selected, disabled, divider.
<NavigationItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, icon, badge, value.
<DrawerItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, icon, trailing, value, section, divider.
<NavigationRail> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: items, value, onChange, header.
<ProgressIndicator> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, value, size, thickness.
<ProgressIndicator> variant must be one of 'linear' | 'circular'.
<RadioButton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: checked, disabled, error, label, name, onChange.
<Scrim> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: opacity, children.
<SearchBar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, placeholder, leading, trailing, onChange.
<Segment> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, icon, value, disabled.
<SideSheet> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, actions, children.
<Slider> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, min, max, step, showValue, stops, onChange.
<Snackbar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: action, onAction, onClose, closeIcon, lines, children.
<Snackbar> lines must be one of 'one' | 'two'.
<SplitButton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, size, icon, trailing, onAction, onMenu, disabled, children.
<SplitButton> variant must be one of 'filled' | 'tonal' | 'elevated' | 'outlined'.
<SplitButton> size must be one of 'xs' | 's' | 'm' | 'l' | 'xl'.
<StatusBar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: time, indicators.
<Switch> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: checked, disabled, withIcon, label, onChange.
<TabItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, icon, value.
<TextField> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, label, value, placeholder, leading, trailing, supportingText, counter, error, disabled, onChange.
<TextField> variant must be one of 'filled' | 'outlined'.
<TimePicker> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: hour, minute, period, mode, unit, onChangeUnit, onChangePeriod, onChangeHour, actions.
<TimePicker> period must be one of 'AM' | 'PM'.
<TimePicker> mode must be one of 'dial' | 'input'.
<TimePicker> unit must be one of 'hour' | 'minute'.
<Toolbar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: orientation, variant, children.
<Toolbar> orientation must be one of 'horizontal' | 'vertical'.
<Toolbar> variant must be one of 'standard' | 'vibrant'.

<TopAppBar> size must be one of 'small' | 'center' | 'medium' | 'large'.
